name: Roubion — Polygon Valley
description: Perseverance sampling site. NASA's inventory lists Roubion (sol 164) at Roubion, Polygon Valley.
scientificQuestion: What would a crew observe and collect here that the rover's cores and instruments could not?
locationProvenance: Rover end-of-drive localization on sol 157 (RMC 6_0), the last localization on or before the first sample was sealed on sol 164. This is the rover's position, not the drill target within arm's reach; no geodetic uncertainty is published.
